verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 API documents real bulk endpoints: POST /v3/payments/bulk pays up to 50 bills, POST /v3/payments/mass pays up to 2000 bills asynchronously, and POST /v3/bills/bulk creates multiple bills in one request. However, all of these sit in the Accounts Payable module, and nothing shows bulk operations on Spend & Expense objects such as cards, budgets, users, transactions or reimbursements. Missing for 10: bulk endpoints for S&E-specific items, bulk update/delete operations beyond creation and payment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
